title: HB1427 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, requires, when neither the seller nor purchaser of a firearm is a licensed gun dealer that the transaction be completed through a licensed gun dealer, and that the dealer perform the same background check required for purchases from licensed gun dealers. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 67, Chapter 6.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2019-02-06; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 1895783)
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2019-02-06; no passage vote on record. Subsection (c) lists exceptions (1)-(3) and subsection (d) sets the dealer process; the tax exemption in (g) is tied to the gun sale rules, so it is not treated as a separate topic.
